body:
Triage (concentrated finding round): promoted `finding` → `pm:queue`, as the **anchor card of a two-card sweep** with #4890 (member). Same catalog file surface (33/39 overlapping files, `examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/**`) and the same ratchet landing spot (`layout-props-conversion.test.tsx`), so one dev, one claim (anchored here), one PR covering both: the 140-node className→props extraction (this card) plus the 135-node `spacing`→`gap` rename and the `stack.tsx` alias removal (#4890). Sweep discipline applies: itemized per-node list (落点 | before | after) in the PR body; zero changes outside the listed nodes; out-of-scope discoveries filed separately.

- Session: `session_012u2pRjcqAYtoEjgr3wwhnK`
- Branch: `claude/issue-4891-catalog-layout-props-sweep`

Dispatched as the **anchor of the two-card sweep**, per triage (comment 5335896302): one dev, one claim here, **one PR covering both this card and #4890** — the 140-node `className` → props extraction, plus #4890's 135-node `spacing` → `gap` rename and the `stack.tsx` alias removal.

Direction is contract-first and fixed by triage: **producer-side rename first, then delete the `(schema as any).spacing` consumer leg. Do not legalize `spacing` into `StackSchema`.**

Sweep discipline carried into the brief: itemized per-node list (落点 | before | after) in the PR body, zero changes outside the listed nodes, out-of-scope discoveries filed separately.

  "summary": "Both cards implemented in one PR as triage ruled (comment 5335896302). Every headline figure was re-measured on origin/main (3b147a367) before any edit and reproduced EXACTLY — this lane's byte-identical outcome, not the drifted one: #4891 = 140 nodes / 33 files with token hits flex 221, container 7, stack 3, grid 0 (231 total); #4890 = 135 nodes / 39 files; all 33 of #4891's files sit inside #4890's 39, so 39 files touched and 272 distinct nodes changed (3 nodes are in both halves). Order followed literally: the 135 producers were renamed spacing->gap first, then the `(schema as any).spacing` leg was deleted from stack.tsx; `spacing` was NOT legalised into StackSchema. Measurement was done by parsing all 423 catalog JSON documents rather than by grep, and edits were applied by byte offset rather than by re-serialising — 12 catalog files carry hand-compacted single-line objects that a JSON.stringify round-trip would have reflowed, which is exactly the out-of-scope churn a sweep must not produce. The ratchet at layout-props-conversion.test.tsx was extended from 'no div carries layout intent' to 'no flex/stack/container/grid hand-writes its own props', plus a spacing ban, a stack-gap value census, and sampled equivalence; a new renderer pin (packages/components/src/__tests__/stack-spacing-alias-removed.test.tsx) holds the alias removal. Changeset: @object-ui/components minor (an undeclared key stopped being honoured), per the repo's no-major rule.",
  "tests": "All from the repo root per AGENTS.md; heavy runs through scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh; exit codes captured before any pipe by a wrapper that propagates them, and every claim below quotes the tool's own verdict line, never a bare $?. UNION RE-RUN AT THE FINAL COMMIT 953c58820 (HEAD printed by the run itself): `pnpm exec vitest run examples/schema-catalog/ packages/components/src/__tests__/stack-spacing-alias-removed.test.tsx packages/components/src/__tests__/container-max-width-false.test.tsx packages/components/src/__tests__/div-deprecation-provenance.test.tsx packages/components/src/__tests__/div-deprecation-warn-once.test.tsx packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardGridLayout.legacyRetired.test.tsx scripts/__tests__/catalog-index-regenerable-4633.test.ts --reporter=verbose --maxWorkers=2` -> `Test Files 15 passed (15) / Tests 1636 passed (1636)`. `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/components --filter=@object-ui/example-schema-catalog --concurrency=2` -> `Tasks: 30 successful, 30 total`, with both packages' `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` echoed (so not a zero-match no-op). `node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs` -> `OK (scanned 4734 tracked text file(s))`, plus a self-scan of the 43 changed files for raw control bytes -> 0 hits. `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs` -> `All workspace packages are in the changeset fixed group.`; `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` -> `No changeset declares a major bump.` DECLARED NARROWING (lint): whole-tree `pnpm lint` is CI's; the narrowing carries all three evidence legs — population from eslint's own config resolution, count from --format json (43 handed in, 3 inside the population, 40 outside), and invariance because eslint.config.js declares no parserOptions.project/projectService and no rule under eslint-rules/ reads another file (no readFileSync/globSync), so every rule is single-file syntactic and this diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict; exit 0, 0 errors, the 2 warnings on stack.tsx pre-existing (this diff removes one `any` and adds none). SUPERSET ARGUMENT for the test set: catalog JSON is reachable only through @object-ui/example-schema-catalog, whose in-repo dependents are apps/site (excluded from every root vitest project by config; no apps/site or content/docs path touched) plus four test files, all included; and the stack.tsx delta is one expression whose output moves ONLY for a node with `spacing` and no `gap`, of which zero remain repo-wide. DIFF-VS-LIST CROSS-CHECK: all 423 documents parsed at HEAD and in the tree and compared pointer by pointer -> changed 272, listed 272, CHANGED-BUT-NOT-LISTED 0, LISTED-BUT-NOT-CHANGED 0, nodes added/removed 0 (set equality both directions); `\"spacing\"` now occurs 0 times in the catalog. ABLATION — 3 legs, direction predicted before running, all matched. NO REBUILD NEEDED AND WHY: the root vitest config aliases @object-ui/components to packages/components/src (vitest.config.mts:264) and the catalog test imports allExamples from '../src/index.js' (line 54), so no dist is in either resolution path and a source mutation takes effect directly — stated rather than assumed. Each leg mutated, proved the mutation ON DISK by counting probes, ran, then restored under `trap ... EXIT INT TERM`, with the restore verified BY SHA256 (all three files byte-identical afterwards; `git status` clean). A) revert one #4891 conversion -> predicted RED on the ratchet AND on the pinned equivalence case; observed exactly those two, `Tests 2 failed | 26 passed`. B) put `spacing: 2` back on one stack -> predicted RED on the spacing ban AND the value census; observed exactly those two, `Tests 2 failed | 26 passed` reporting `expected 1 to be +0`. C) restore the deleted `?? (schema as any).spacing` -> predicted exactly one failure with the flex/gap/gap:0 cases unaffected; observed `Tests 1 failed | 3 passed`. VOID LEG REPORTED, NOT SILENTLY RETRIED: leg B's FIRST attempt was declared void by its own on-disk guard. The mutation had landed, but the confirmation used `grep -F` with a MULTI-LINE pattern, which grep treats as several patterns and counts matching lines for, so the 'this text is gone' probe returned 3 instead of 0. The reading was discarded and the leg re-run with single-line counting probes (`\"gap\": 2,` 3->2 and `\"spacing\": 2,` 0->1); the row above is that second, valid run. Leg C is what makes the new renderer pin non-phantom: `spacing: 6` was chosen because 6 is a mapped ladder step, so a live alias renders md:gap-6 and fails loudly instead of coinciding with the default.",
  "open_questions": [],
  "out_of_scope_findings": [
    "filed as #5690 (finding, unassigned): nine catalog `flex` nodes still spell horizontal spacing as `space-x-*` — same reader-facing shape as this card but a different mechanism (a margin on a sibling selector, not the flexbox gap), so it is not a mechanical rename and a conversion moves rendering; excluding it is precisely why this card's 221-token flex figure re-measured to the digit. `space-y-*` on a stack: 0 nodes, measured.",
    "NOT filed — already open as #5574, so the measurement was posted there as a comment instead of duplicating the issue: flex/stack/container spread their schema keys onto the DOM element (the leak PR #5573 closed for grid via toDomProps). That issue lists these three as 'candidates to measure'; measured over the whole catalog through the real SchemaRenderer: 662 stray attributes (flex[align] 198, flex[gap] 184, stack[gap] 153, flex[justify] 98, container[padding] 14, container[maxwidth] 6, flex[direction] 5, stack[align] 4), with grid reading ZERO as the control that the probe is not blind. 231 of those are new as of this sweep, because declared props are what leak — worth PM's attention as sizing input for #5574, not as a reason to hold this PR.",
    "recorded on the PR, not filed: GitHub's body sanitizer ate one angle-bracket-delimited placeholder from a fenced code block in the PR body (the AGENTS.md 'GitHub mutates body BYTES' behaviour). Both per-node tables and the session-URL footer survived byte-intact; the command was re-spelled in a PR comment rather than re-posting a 28k-character body."
  ]
}
